newsitem.title: USA: MCI to offer ATM link to Britain in 1998.
newsitem.headline: MCI to offer ATM link to Britain in 1998.

text.p: MCI Communications Corp on Monday it was preparing to offer its HyperStream ATM service to Britain by 1998.

The U.S.-based telephone company said the Asynchronous Transfer Mode (ATM) data service was commercially viable for companies and government agencies that required large bandwidth and fast data transfers.
It said it would link the service with British Telecommunications Plc's CellStream ATM service.
In October, MCI and BT said they would expand the ATM service to additional countries in 1997.

ATM is the industry standard for integrated broadband communications, designed to handle multimedia applications -- a mix of voice, data and imaging. Broadband services include video and three-dimensional graphics, among others.
MCI is planning to merge with BT to form Concert, creating the world's second-largest telecommunications group.
